role: Tests for CloudKitSyncManager's locally testable logic on a manager of the test's own (temporary archive, settings and sync state): which sessions the direct upload takes, the upload/deletion no-op guards, the onboarding gate, a disabled full sync clearing an error to idle, JSON+compression round trip, permanent-schema and zone-already-gone error classification, sanitize-drip and health-scrub list handling, resetLocalSyncState, and the iCloud account verdict and confirmation.
types: CloudKitSyncManagerTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over a CloudKitSyncManager built by CloudKitSyncManager.isolated
state: directory: <tmp>/CloudKitSyncManagerTests-<uuid> (created in setUp, removed in tearDown)
settings: lazy fresh SettingsManager on directory/user_settings.json
manager: lazy CloudKitSyncManager.isolated over archive, directory and settings
hostSyncDefaults: HostDefaults of HostDefaults.cloudSyncBookkeeping and the Health-scrub list keys, set aside in setUp and restored in tearDown
toplevel: Lazy settings, archive and manager, built on first use in a test after setUp has created the directory and set the host's defaults aside.
